notes:
### Fixed

- **Copy copies everything you selected on a web page.** On a page with answers to pick — a quiz, a form — Copy gave the question and nothing of the answers, and paragraphs ran together. Now the app you selected in copies it itself, so what you paste is what that app's own Copy gives: every answer, a line each, with its formatting and links. Where an app copies nothing, the bar copies the text it read, which Lumi 1.59.0 now reads whole on any page — so Translate, Search and the AI actions get every answer too.
- Needs Lumi 1.59.0.

notes:
### Added

notes:
### Added

- **Reply…** — for a message someone sent you. The AI reads it first and offers the ways you are likeliest to answer it, a few words each — "3 pm works for me", "Suggest 4 pm instead", "Ask what the review covers" — and a field to say your own. Pick one and it writes the reply along it, in the message's language and your voice, to copy and send. Back goes to the ways again, and ↻ on them asks for others. Its sheet has two sets of instructions: which ways to offer, and how to write the reply. However you word the first, the bar asks for the ways one a line, so they can always be listed; should none come back, the field is still there. The ways come in your Mac's language; the way you pick goes to the model with the message, as text to work on, never as instructions.
- **Text you can't edit**, under an AI action's Shows for: a message, a page — where Reply… shows, and where an action of your own can too.

### Fixed

- The Settings tab no longer says every AI action needs a model when Lumi has one. Lumi lets the tab ask the bar anything only while Settings is in front, and a tab loaded behind another app — Lumi reopening Settings as it starts, or a new version arriving — was refused, and showed what it could not read as none: no model, no translator, an empty sample bar. It now reads them again as Settings comes to the front, waits longer while the bar is busy starting, and until it knows, says nothing either way.

notes:
### Added

- **Each bar its own settings for an action.** An action's gear on the While holding ⌥ tab opens its sheet for that bar: Use the main bar's settings, on at first, shows the main bar's settings dimmed — what the bar asks with, changed from the Main tab. Turned off, the bar has its own — instructions, model, thinking, when it shows and what its answer is for, Translate's translator and languages, Search's site — starting as a copy of the main bar's, so Fix Spelling & Grammar can ask a quick model on one bar and a careful one on the other. Turned back on, its own are kept for the next time it is turned off. Each sheet says at its top which bar it saves for, and the While holding ⌥ tab marks an action with settings of its own there. An action of your own keeps one name and icon on both bars.
- **Ask… chooses its model before the first question.** Under the question's field, the model it goes to and how hard it thinks — Ask…'s own — open Ask With: pick another model or thinking, Done, and the question asks with it, and the chat after it too.

### Fixed

- The model at the foot of an AI card is as tall as the card's buttons, and its corner follows the panel's: under Ask…'s first question, alone in its footer, it had shrunk to its text, its lit background against the panel's edge.

notes:
### Fixed

- In Ask…'s chat, Return in the follow-up field sends the question again: the bar's own keys had taken it while the bar held the keyboard.
- The follow-up field shows its caret only while what you type goes into it. In an app that answers Accessibility nothing while the bar has the keyboard — Chromium and Electron apps, Visual Studio Code — reading the selection for the question lent the keyboard back to the app, and the field kept a caret that typing never reached: the bar went instead. With Lumi 1.55.0 the keyboard comes back to the bar once the question is asked, so typing goes on into the field; with an older Lumi, a press on the field gives it back.

notes:
### Added

- **Ask… is a chat.** Once it has answered, a field under the answer takes the next question, and the model is asked it with the chat so far — your earlier questions with its instructions, its earlier answers after the selected text, as text to work on, never as instructions — so "which part?" or "make it friendlier" follow on. The card keeps every question and answer in turn, the newest last, as a messages app draws them — yours on the right in the accent colour, the model's on the left — each answer with a Copy of its own beside it — shown as you point at the answer, and on the latest until you point at another — that leaves the chat up — in place of the footer's Copy, which took the last answer and put the bar away — and ↻ asks the last one again with the same chat. The latest eight questions go with each, and of a long answer its first 3,000 characters. Like a translation, the chat goes when the bar does.

Nút làm mới hỏi lại câu hỏi cuối cùng với toàn bộ cuộc trò chuyện

notes:
### Changed

### Added

- Every AI action's instructions are yours to change, with its default one press away: the gear on its row in Settings opens them, with when it shows, what its answer is for, the language it answers in, the model it asks and how hard it thinks. The translation appears in a card, made on your Mac by the translator built into macOS
On a Mac set to English in Vietnam, English becomes Vietnamese and everything else English
Press either language name to choose another from a list showing what is on your Mac
Copy puts the translation on the clipboard, Replace writes it over your selection
When a language is not on your Mac yet, Download opens the macOS prompt

vi.headline: Dịch văn bản ngay trên máy Mac
items: Nhấn Dịch trên thanh công cụ để đọc nội dung đã chọn bằng ngôn ngữ của bạn
Bản dịch xuất hiện trong thẻ, được tạo trên máy Mac bằng trình dịch tích hợp sẵn của macOS
Trên máy Mac đặt tiếng Anh ở Việt Nam, tiếng Anh chuyển sang tiếng Việt và ngược lại
Nhấn tên ngôn ngữ để chọn ngôn ngữ khác từ danh sách hiển thị những gì có trên máy Mac
Sao chép đưa bản dịch vào clipboard, Thay thế ghi đè lên nội dung đã chọn
Khi ngôn ngữ chưa có trên máy Mac, Tải xuống mở hộp thoại của macOS

notes:
### Added

- Select text with the mouse in any app — drag across it, double-click a word or triple-click a line — and a small bar of actions shows up beside it. It never takes the keyboard from the app, and goes away when you click, type or scroll somewhere else.
- Nothing on the bar is lit when it comes up — not the button the pointer was last over, nor the first button when the shortcut opens it. The arrow keys light the button they move to.
- Escape backs out of the menus a level at a time — a group opened from More back to More, then to the bar — and then puts the bar away, also when the bar came up for the mouse: opening a menu gives it the keyboard.
- A menu with more items than fit, such as Case, keeps to a width and scrolls sideways: swipe on the trackpad or turn the mouse wheel. The way back stays put, and the ends fade where items are hidden. The first few times one opens, its items slide a little to the left and back, to show they scroll.
- The bar starts with Lumi's mark and name, so you can tell where it comes from. Menus opened in it keep their room for their items.
- After a double-click the bar waits a fifth of a second, in case a third click makes it a triple-click, so selecting a line by triple-clicking shows it once, not twice. With a slower double-click speed in macOS, it waits longer. In Settings it can also show at once, or a moment after every selection.
- Select text with the keyboard too — ⇧ and the arrow keys, ⇧⌥ by words, ⌘A — and the bar shows up once you stop and let go. Typing over what you selected never brings it up. Turn it off in Settings. Or keep it to ⇧ with the arrow keys and ⌘A, so a command that leaves text selected — ⌘F filling its field, ⌘L an address bar — does not bring it up.
- **Copy** and **Search** for any text. **Open link** for a web address, **New email** for an email address, the answer to a sum such as `1280 * 0.15 + 42`, and **Format JSON** for JSON.
- **Case**, **Lines** and **Encode**, each opening in the bar with Lumi's own changes: UPPERCASE, Title Case, snake_case, Sort lines, Remove duplicate lines, Base64, URL encode and more. The change is written over what you selected and stays selected, with the bar beside it, so you can make another.
- **Count** shows the words, characters and lines in what you selected. It is off at first; turn it on in Settings.
- Press **⌃⌥⌘Space** for the same bar from the keyboard, in any app: numbers or arrow keys choose, Return presses, Escape closes. Each button shows its number while you use the keys — not when you open a menu with the mouse.
- In Settings: show the bar when you select text or only with the shortcut; its look — Dark, Light or Match macOS — and its size; whether it shows on the pointer's side of the text, above it or below it; icons or icons and names; the search engine; and which actions show, each with its own switch, in the order you drag them to. A preview at the top shows the bar as you set it, for a few words, a link, an email address, a sum, JSON or several lines. Press the shortcut's keys there to record another.
- Copy shows a tick before the bar goes, and a change still being made shows a spinner on its button.
- **Settings…** is under ⋯ on the bar.
- **Not in…** under ⋯ on the bar keeps it from showing by itself in that app. The shortcut still works there.
- Needs Lumi 1.50.0.

en.headline: Select text and a bar of actions shows up beside it
items: Select text with the mouse or keyboard and a small bar shows up beside it
Press Escape to back out of menus one level at a time, then close the bar
Menus with many items scroll sideways and fade at the ends where items are hidden
The bar waits after a double-click in case a third click makes it a triple-click
Copy, Search, Open link, New email, answer sums, Format JSON, Case, Lines, Encode and Count
Press Control-Option-Command-Space to open the bar from the keyboard in any app

vi.headline: Chọn văn bản và thanh công cụ hiện lên bên cạnh
items: Chọn văn bản bằng chuột hoặc bàn phím và thanh công cụ nhỏ hiện lên bên cạnh
Nhấn Escape để thoát khỏi menu từng cấp một, sau đó đóng thanh công cụ
Menu có nhiều mục cuộn ngang và mờ dần ở hai đầu nơi các mục bị ẩn
Thanh công cụ đợi sau khi nhấp đúp phòng khi nhấp lần ba biến thành nhấp ba
Sao chép, Tìm kiếm, Mở liên kết, Email mới, tính toán, Định dạng JSON, Chữ hoa/thường, Dòng, Mã hóa và Đếm
Nhấn Control-Option-Command-Space để mở thanh công cụ từ bàn phím trong bất kỳ ứng dụng nào
